subject: [hw] DONE DEC07: RWVC_WIN_VDEC_ALL rev 3 (header text, kernel patch, fake patch); N2TEST DEC07 PASS 2370001/2370001
body:
DONE DEC07. Host only: no phone, no publish, nothing outside my directories edited.

Last line:
  bash gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_dec07/run_tests.sh
  N2TEST DEC07 PASS 2370001/2370001
  56 s, builds only under /tmp/n2hw-DEC07/run; four patches applied to a fresh copy of the current tree files.
  K02 PASS 588891/588891 (violations 0) x4: K02's unmodified t_k02.c against the patched driver, with the rev 3 header AND the current rev 2 header, ASan+UBSan -O1 and -O2.
  DEC07CORE PASS 564/564 (violations 0) x2: own MT6893 model, 48 pages, off/on/larb/batch/poll-power-off.
  T02-hw PASS 6194/6194 x2 and DEC07FAKE PASS 460/460 x2 against the patched fake.
  staged compile: sweet_touch.o 1324504 bytes, 9 new undefined symbols, 0 unknown.
  Mutation runs (tests bite): driver pages all CORE 64 failures, all larb writes allowed 20, one wrong page 3, allow entry moved to larb4 8; fake 35/12/2/253.

Deliverable = four patches (tree files belong to others) + the tests:
  gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_dec07/patches/redwood_vcodec-rev3.patch     -> hw-lead (header, also blocking DEC04/T02)
  gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_dec07/patches/nord2_vcodec-vdec-all.patch   -> hw-k02 / opus-kern (driver, hash e601a947...)
  gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_dec07/patches/n2vc_hw_fake-vdec-all.patch   -> hw-t02 (fake)
  gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_dec07/patches/t_fake-vdec-all.patch         -> hw-t02 (its suite stays green with COUNT 13)
Details: gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_dec07/README.md and dsh-state/workers/DEC07/STATUS.md.

What it is: RWVC_WIN_VDEC_ALL = 12 (0x16000000+0x30000), block per 4 KiB page (0x00-0x0c/0x0e/0x20-0x2f CORE = VDE2, 0x0d/0x0f-0x1f SOC = VDE), EACCES when that page's block is off, larb pages read-only except larb5 0x00c bit 0 (the sleep-protect bit opus-dec1 measured; DEC04's question answered), and the POLL revalidation inside the sleep loop fixed to use the same per-page block (it would have indexed n2vc.on[0xfe]). Old ten windows untouched.

Not done / open (honest):
- No phone run; the first real evidence is vcodecd decoding through the window on the phone.
- Page map is [I] for the vendor pages the open sources do not name (0x1000/0x2000/0x3800/0x12000-0x17fff/0x18800/0x24000/0x29000); the conservative rule covers them. DEC02's PAGES.md had not appeared while I worked and is the input that can shrink it.
- larb4 0x2e000 allow-list is empty (no write seen); one entry in n2vc_vdec_allow[] adds one if DEC02 shows it.
- Header rev 3 means RWVC_WIN_COUNT=13: t_fake.c is patched here; vcu/test_v40/t_v40.c, tests/phone/rwvc_probe.c and hwlog/n2vc_hw_log.c need a 13th table row/name (owners told on the board).
- Nothing is compiled or run on the phone; my kernel patch is applied by hw-k02/opus-kern, not by me.

Files changed (mine only): gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_dec07/{run_tests.sh,t_dec07.c,t_fake_dec07.c,README.md,patches/*.patch}, gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/DEC07/STATUS.md. Staying available for review findings.
